criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use a high oblique isometric projection with no horizon.
Roads and building footprints follow matching diagonal diamond axes.
different: Candidate framing is slightly wider, exposing more empty terrain above the city.
Reference framing gives larger foreground facilities and denser edge cropping.

evidence.observation: Oblique map view has consistent diagonal roads, visible wall elevations, and no horizon.
The same projection and yaw are visible, with somewhat more open terrain in frame.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both mass a dense residential district at lower right and industry toward the upper left.
Both preserve a rocky utility corridor between the major built masses.
different: Reference fills the lower-left with a second large industrial district.
Candidate leaves substantially more open terrain along the river and upper-right map.

evidence.observation: Industry occupies both left corners while dense housing fills most of the right half.
Development is concentrated in the upper-left plant and lower-right city, with broader empty corridors.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both depict a dark rocky channel with misty banks separating plant and city.
Both integrate diagonal road or utility crossings into the river corridor.
different: Reference water runs obliquely across the middle and lower-left map.
Candidate forms a narrower north-south S-curve with stronger pale reflections and deeper-looking banks.

evidence.observation: A broad, dark channel bends diagonally through the central and lower-left terrain.
A more vertical reflective channel curves from the top center toward the bottom edge.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Substations remain larger than houses but smaller than generation complexes.
Transmission towers, hospital, and industrial landmarks retain comparable silhouette hierarchy.
different: Candidate central substation is slightly larger relative to its neighboring buildings.
Candidate upper-left plant occupies a broader footprint relative to nearby pylons.

evidence.observation: Plant, pylons, and central substation establish a consistent large-to-medium landmark hierarchy.
The same hierarchy is present, though the plant and central substation read somewhat larger.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both combine blackened metal, soot-dark soil, weathered concrete, and sparse amber window light.
Fine industrial detailing and cyan emissive accents are cohesive in both maps and panels.
different: Candidate terrain is marginally darker and hazier, with coarser exposed rock.
Reference carries stronger cyan wash and slightly brighter midtone separation.

evidence.observation: Dark textured ground, metal facilities, amber lights, and vivid cyan glow share one material treatment.
Matching distressed industrial materials appear under darker, smokier lighting.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both distinguish energized solid cyan conductors from planned amber dashed conductors.
Both route cyan power from the plant through pylons and substations toward the city.
different: Reference includes broad translucent cyan service-radius fields around substations.
Candidate uses fewer visible intermediate pylons and a cleaner, shorter cyan trunk.

evidence.observation: Cyan routes, amber planned towers, and two large cyan coverage fields are simultaneously readable.
Solid cyan and dashed amber routes remain clear, but coverage fields are absent and the tower chain is shorter.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use distressed industrial chrome with a full-width status header, left tool kit, and right inspector.
The inspector preserves the same landmark image, capacity bar, green status light, and two action buttons.
different: Candidate adds persistent text captions to the tool kit and inspector title.
Reference uses a compact playback rail where candidate allocates a wider staged bottom overlay.

evidence.observation: A segmented metal header presents settings, budget, power, date, and pause status.
The same segmented header structure appears with localized labels and slightly tighter height.
The left kit is predominantly icon-only and framed by heavy metal borders.

criteria.label: WEAK
similar: Both occupy a centered bottom chrome rail with segmented rectangular controls.
Both combine icons and numerals with one cyan-highlighted current item.
different: Reference rail controls playback speed with x1, x2, and x4 states rather than event stages.
Candidate presents five numbered stages with arrows and explicit construction-to-result progression.

evidence.observation: Four transport-style controls show reverse, play, and speed multipliers.
Five numbered event cards show a highlighted construction stage followed by power, result, and next-stage cards.
